# Assignment: Senior Full-Stack Designer Challenge

## Objective

This assignment is designed to test whether you can do the actual work of a Senior Full-Stack Designer at Ajaia.

We want to assess your ability to:
- improve a high-visibility website experience
- design a polished product UI flow
- create a strong brand/growth asset
- use AI tools in a practical, high-leverage way
- communicate your design decisions clearly

This role spans product design, website design, and client-facing visual communication. Your submission should reflect strong taste, speed, execution quality, and AI-native workflow discipline.

## Time Limit

Please spend **no more than 4 hours total** on this assignment.

We are not looking for maximum volume. We are looking for judgment, prioritization, quality, and AI-native execution.

## Part 1: Website Redesign

Choose **one page** from the Ajaia website to redesign.

Website: https://ajaia.ai

### Your task
Redesign the page of your choice to significantly improve:
- visual quality
- clarity of information
- hierarchy
- conversion potential
- interaction design
- animation/motion behavior

### Requirements
Your redesign should include:
- a full-page redesign
- responsive consideration
- clear animation and motion direction
- a polished visual system appropriate for Ajaia’s brand
- modern, production-minded design thinking

You may use any tool you prefer, including AI-assisted design tools.

### What to include
Please provide:
- the original page you selected
- your redesigned version
- a short explanation of why you chose that page
- a short explanation of the animation/motion system

## Part 2: Product UI Flow

Design a UI flow for the following product concept:

### Product Brief
**AI Translator for Healthcare**  
Real-time, medically accurate translation that improves patient communication and clinical workflows.

### Outcome
Clear, instant communication that reduces errors and accelerates care.

### Top 3 pains solved
- Misunderstandings that risk incorrect diagnosis or treatment
- Delays caused by unavailable interpreters
- Compliance risks from using unsecured translation tools

### Core Features
- Real-Time Audio & Text Translation
- HIPAA-Ready, Secure Architecture
- Cross-Device Access
- Multi-Language Auto-Detection
- Clinical Clarity Filters
- Workflow-Optimized Communication

### Your task
Create a UI flow for this product.

You may define the flow, but it should feel realistic for a healthcare setting. For example, you might design a flow for:
- intake or triage translation
- bedside communication
- telehealth translation
- doctor-patient conversation support
- review/export of translated interaction history

### Requirements
Your product flow should demonstrate:
- strong UX thinking
- clean information hierarchy
- trust and clarity in a healthcare context
- realistic workflow design
- thoughtful handling of speed, usability, and compliance-sensitive contexts

### What to include
Please provide:
- key screens for the flow
- a brief explanation of the user journey
- important states or interactions
- any assumptions you made

## Part 3: LinkedIn Post + Graphic

Create **one LinkedIn post** and **one supporting graphic** based on any idea, insight, or takeaway from this report:

**2026 AI Reality Check Report**  
https://ajaia.ai/2026-ai-reality-check-report

### Your task
Create a LinkedIn post that feels native to Ajaia’s style and audience.

The post should feel:
- credible
- sharp
- practical
- operator-minded
- AI-forward
- written for executives, operators, and enterprise teams focused on real implementation

The supporting graphic should be visually strong, on-brand, and appropriate for LinkedIn.

### What to include
Please provide:
- the final LinkedIn post copy
- the final graphic
- a 1-2 sentence note explaining the angle you chose

## AI-Native Workflow Note

AI usage is a core expectation of this role.

Please include a short note describing:
- which AI tools you used
- where they helped
- how they accelerated your process
- what design decisions or refinements were yours

We are not evaluating whether you avoided AI. We are evaluating how effectively you used it.

Please upload this as an **unlisted YouTube video** and include the link in your submission.

We will evaluate your submission based on:

- strength of visual design
- quality of hierarchy and layout
- website thinking and conversion awareness
- motion and interaction design judgment
- UX quality in the product flow

- consistency across product, web, and brand surfaces
- quality of the LinkedIn content and graphic
- AI-native workflow maturity
- clarity of communication in your walkthrough

## Constraints

- Maximum time: **4 hours**
- You may use any design tools or AI tools you prefer
- Do not overproduce beyond the requested scope
- Prioritize quality, judgment, and polish over quantity
